1.why: All screens use a clean, legible sans-serif typeface with comfortable line and paragraph spacing.

2.why: Instructions are sentence case with no italics or dense blocks; only the 'NORTHSTAR BANK' wordmark and acronyms like 'MFA' appear in capitals.

3.why: The single-column mobile layout is generally readable, but the long otpauth URI wraps awkwardly and stacked error banners in steps 13–17 badly clutter the small screen.

4.why: Instructions are one or two short plain sentences, though jargon such as 'provisioning value' and 'provisioning representation' appears on the authenticator step.

5.why: The recovery-code field shows a format example placeholder 'ABCD-EFGH-JKLM' and demo credentials are displayed, but the verification and authenticator code fields show no example of the expected input.

6.why: Every screen's prose is limited to one or two short sentences; no long block of text must be read to proceed.

7.why: The manual secret and recovery codes are rendered as ordinary page text that can be selected and copied, although no dedicated copy button is provided.

8.why: No QR code is rendered despite the instruction to 'scan the provisioning value'; only a plain-text otpauth URI string is shown.

9.why: The login uses standard labelled text and password inputs, but autofill or password-manager support cannot be confirmed or refuted from the screenshots.

10.why: Each screen has a clear step heading and a prominent full-width dark-green primary button, though there is no step-of-N progress indicator.

11.why: Each step centres on a single submission, though the recovery-codes page offers two buttons and 'Authenticator / Recovery codes / Log out' links persist on every screen.

12.why: Successful actions get plain confirmations such as 'MFA is enabled', but failures show 'Unable to continue sign-in.' or a raw exception with no statement of what happened or what comes next, and the banners accumulate uncleared.

13.why: Steps can be retried without lockout (eight-plus failed sign-in attempts) and replacement recovery codes can be generated freely, though no resend-verification link or reveal/hide control is visible.

14.why: Error messages are a vague 'Unable to continue sign-in.' and a raw 'Failed to execute insertBefore on Node' DOM exception, neither stating the problem nor how to fix it.

15.why: No reading timer is shown, but the verification code is explicitly 'short-lived' and authenticator codes 'rotate every 30 seconds', so entry time is limited rather than generous.
